name: Jessica Clinton Park Perimeter
location: 3200 SE Southbend Blvd, Port St. Lucie
safety: Open 8:00 AM–10:00 PM. The perimeter is listed as lighted, but do not assume equal illumination after the 9:30 PM sports-light curfew.

name: Winterlakes Park Trail System
location: 5241 NW Jannebo St, Port St. Lucie
safety: A pathway-lighting project was still underway with estimated completion in August 2026; do not assume current lighting.

name: Oak Hammock Park Trails
location: 1982 SW Villanova Road, Port St. Lucie
safety: Open 7:00 AM–sunset. Exact surface and trail lighting are not stated; expect a natural route through oak and palm hammocks.

name: McCarty Ranch Preserve Trails
location: 12525 Range Line Road, Port St. Lucie
surface: Cleared trails; exact material not stated
safety: Open 8:00 AM–sunset. Trails are shared with bicycles and horses and may close because of wet ground or standing water.

name: Woodland Trails Park
location: 1485 SW Calmar Avenue, Port St. Lucie
safety: Open 8:00 AM–sunset. No trail lighting is listed; be attentive near the dog-park entrance and shared recreation areas.

name: Rosser Lakes Preserve
location: 3792 SW Rosser Boulevard, Port St. Lucie
surface: Hiking/biking trails; exact material not stated
safety: Posted access is 8:00 AM to dusk. Parking, restrooms, water, lighting, and mileage were not verified on the official page.

name: The Boardwalk at The Port District
location: 2200 SE Veterans Memorial Pkwy, from Veterans Park at Rivergate to Tom Hooper Park
safety: Open 24/7. Expect pedestrians and anglers in the shared waterside corridor; parking and restrooms are verified at the Veterans Park endpoint.
